questions.question: Clarify the wording of Kronecker’s academy memberships, the consistency theorem and the Kronecker delta.

localizations.source: Clarify the wording of Kronecker’s academy memberships, the consistency theorem and the Kronecker delta.
localizations.ru: Уточнить формулировки о членстве Кронекера в академиях, теореме о совместности и дельте Кронекера.

questions.resolution: Memberships are stated without disputed dates; the result is named the Kronecker–Capelli theorem, and the unsupported date for the delta was removed.

questions.question: Distinguish the quotation attributed to Kronecker from the author’s assessment of his disputes with other schools.

localizations.source: Distinguish the quotation attributed to Kronecker from the author’s assessment of his disputes with other schools.
localizations.ru: Разграничить приписываемую Кронекеру цитату и авторскую оценку его споров с другими школами.

questions.resolution: The quotation is marked as attributed to Kronecker; evaluative language was replaced by a neutral account of the philosophical and mathematical disputes.

questions.question: Identify a verifiable primary source, author or photographer, date and licence or confirmed public-domain status for the portrait of Leopold Kronecker.

localizations.source: Identify a verifiable primary source, author or photographer, date and licence or confirmed public-domain status for the portrait of Leopold Kronecker.
localizations.ru: Установить проверяемый первоисточник, автора или фотографа, дату и лицензию либо подтверждённый public-domain status портрета Леопольда Кронекера.

questions.question: Resolve Kronecker’s professorial rank at the University of Berlin in 1883: the Prussian state archive catalogue describes an appointment as ordentlicher Professor, while Deutsche Biographie says außerordentlicher (ao.) Professor; align RU and EN with the verified archival record.

localizations.source: Resolve Kronecker’s professorial rank at the University of Berlin in 1883: the Prussian state archive catalogue describes an appointment as ordentlicher Professor, while Deutsche Biographie says außerordentlicher (ao.) Professor; align RU and EN with the verified archival record.
localizations.ru: Уточнить профессорский статус Кронекера в Берлинском университете в 1883 году: каталог Прусского тайного государственного архива указывает ordentlicher Professor, а Deutsche Biographie — außerordentlicher (ao.) Professor; согласовать RU/EN по проверенному архивному документу.
